id.description: New lowercase slug id, shaped like the existing ids (e.g. grad-5, skill-3) and used by no existing fact

text.description: English wording, only what Ba wrote (translated faithfully when he wrote Vietnamese)

textVi.description: Vietnamese wording, a faithful translation (or Ba's own Vietnamese)

tags.description: Short lowercase tags taken from Ba's text, e.g. aws, docker

org.description: Organisation: one Ba named, or an existing fact's org he refers to; else null

dates.description: Dates Ba gave, or the existing fact's dates when he refers to that role; else null

facts.description: 1–5 facts from Ba's text; empty when his text says no or gives nothing to add

notes.description: A short note for Ba: why there is no fact, or which detail you left out because he did not give it; null if none

item.description: The checklist item, copied from bot.json selfCheck

note.description: Why it passed or failed; null when nothing to add

selfCheck.description: One entry per selfCheck item in bot.json. Any failed item fails the attempt.

memoryNotes.description: Up to 3 short lessons for this bot's memory, e.g. 'TopCV upload limit is 5MB'. Empty if none.
